name: alps-writer
description: Author Full or Lite ALPS documents, research their evidence and errors, and hand Full ALPS features off to ADR authoring.

interface.shortDescription: Write guided Full or Lite product requirements
interface.longDescription: Create and resume Full or Lite ALPS documents with guided questions, explicit approval, and Markdown export. Optionally review item evidence and errors through built-in deep research or web search with DuckDuckGo MCP fallback. Transfer Full ALPS features to ADR Writer when requested.
defaultPrompt: Start a new ALPS product requirements document.
Start a Lite ALPS document for a mockup or PoC.
Convert the approved ALPS features into ADR drafts.
